# SuspiciousSemicolon

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `SuspiciousSemicolonInspection`

A lone `;` used as the body of an `if`/`elseif`/`else` or of a loop makes that
body empty; the block that follows then runs unconditionally (or only once,
after the loop). This is nearly always an accidental semicolon.

## Example

```php{3,4,5,10,11,12,13}
<?php
function poll($queue, $ready, $late) {
    if ($ready) ;
    elseif ($late) ;
    else ;
    {
        notify();
    }

    while ($queue->next()) ;
    do ; while ($queue->busy());
    for ($i = 3; $i > 0; $i--) ;
    foreach ($queue as $job) ;
    if ($late) { ; }
    declare(ticks=1);
    notify();;
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
<li>line 4: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
<li>line 5: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
<li>line 10: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
<li>line 11: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
<li>line 12: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
<li>line 13: This &#39;;&#39; is the entire body of the statement; probably unintended.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SuspiciousSemicolon": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SuspiciousSemicolon

/**
 * @noinspection SuspiciousSemicolonInspection
 */
```
